<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md for checks, translations, contract tests and the changelog (a file in changelog.d/, never CHANGELOG.md). -->

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. For a feature, link the issue where a maintainer agreed to it.

## Validation

List the checks you ran (`bun run check fast`, `full`, or which single commands and files) with their results, and the ones you skipped. For HTTP/WS changes, include contract-test coverage.
